Class CentralLookup

java.lang.Object
org.openide.util.Lookup
org.openide.util.lookup.AbstractLookup
dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.CentralLookup
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class CentralLookup extends org.openide.util.lookup.AbstractLookup
Class used to house anything one might want to store in a central lookup which can affect anything within the application. It can be thought of as a central context where any application data may be stored and watched. This class has convenience method to modify the contents of the lookup. For stricter separation of reading and writing lookup content see lookup content

A singleton instance is created using getDefault(). This class is as thread safe as Lookup. Lookup appears to be safe.

Version:
1.0
Author:
Wade Chandler

    • getDefault

      public static CentralLookup getDefault()
      Returns the default CentralLookup. This can be used as an application context for the entire application. If needed CentralLookup may be used directly through the constructors to allow for more than one if needed. CentralLookup is nothing more than an InstanceContent instance wrapped in a Lookup with the add and remove methods added to make updating the data easier.
      Returns:
      The default CentralLookup which is global in nature.
